GroupPermissions.AccessUpdated: The group '%1$s' now has the role '%3$s' for '%2$s'.
GroupPermissions.AddAutoAccessRule: Give this group access to new websites matching
GroupPermissions.AddUserToGroup: Add a new member to this group
GroupPermissions.AllWebsitesNote: "Apply to all websites" changes the role of a group for every website you administer. The current roles of the groups are not shown in this view.
GroupPermissions.ApplyAutoAccessRuleConfirm: Apply the rule '%1$s' to all existing websites? The group '%2$s' gets the role '%3$s' (and the capabilities of the rule) for every matching website, unless it already has a higher role.
GroupPermissions.AutoAccessCapabilitiesHelp: Optional: capabilities the group gets in addition to the role.
GroupPermissions.AutoAccessDescription: Rules give this group a role for every website created from now on that is in a matching website group or has a matching URL (main URL or alias URL). Existing websites are only changed when you apply a rule to them.
GroupPermissions.AutoAccessRuleAdded: The rule has been added. It applies to websites created from now on.
GroupPermissions.AutoAccessRuleApplied: The rule has been applied to %s website(s).
GroupPermissions.AutoAccessRuleRemoved: The rule has been removed. Access already given by it is kept.
GroupPermissions.CapabilityAdded: The group '%1$s' now has the capability '%2$s' for '%3$s'.
GroupPermissions.CapabilityRemoved: The capability '%2$s' has been removed from the group '%1$s' for '%3$s'.
GroupPermissions.ChangeAccessToAllSitesConfirm: Are you sure you want to give '%s' access to the group '%s' for all the websites?
GroupPermissions.DashboardCopiedToGroup: Dashboard copied to %1$s member(s) of the group '%2$s'.
GroupPermissions.DeleteGroupConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete the group '%s'?
GroupPermissions.DeleteGroupDescription: Deleting a group removes the access its members got through it. The users themselves are not deleted.
GroupPermissions.DescriptionAccessTab: Decide which groups have access to your websites. You can also give access to all the websites at once by choosing "Apply to all websites" in the website selector.
GroupPermissions.DescriptionGroupsTab: Create groups, add users to them and give the groups access to websites. Every member gets the access of all their groups (the highest role wins).
GroupPermissions.ExceptionAnonymousNotAllowed: The anonymous user cannot be added to a group.
GroupPermissions.ExceptionEmptyPattern: Please enter a website group or URL.
GroupPermissions.ExceptionGroupNameTooLong: The group name is too long (at most %s characters, special characters like quotes count as several characters).
GroupPermissions.ExceptionInvalidMatchType: The match type must be one of: %1$s. Given: %2$s
GroupPermissions.ExceptionNoCapabilitiesWithoutRole: The group '%1$s' needs a role for the website with ID %2$s before it can get capabilities.
GroupPermissions.ExceptionNoGroupSelected: Please select at least one group.
GroupPermissions.ExceptionPatternTooLong: The pattern is too long (at most %s characters).
GroupPermissions.ExceptionRuleDoesExist: This group already has a rule with this pattern.
GroupPermissions.ExceptionSegmentNotFound: The segment %s does not exist or you are not allowed to share it. You can only share segments you created yourself.
GroupPermissions.GiveAccess: Give this group access to a website
GroupPermissions.GroupNameHelp: For example the name of a team or department.
GroupPermissions.GroupRenamed: The group has been renamed to '%s'.
GroupPermissions.IncludedInGroupRole: included in the role of the group
GroupPermissions.InviteUser: Invite a new user to groups
GroupPermissions.InviteUserDescription: Invite a new user by email and add them directly to the selected groups. The user gets access to websites through these groups only.
GroupPermissions.InviteUserIntoGroup: Invite a new user into this group
GroupPermissions.InviteUserSuccess: The user '%s' has been invited and added to the selected groups.
GroupPermissions.MemberAdded: '%s' has been added to the group.
GroupPermissions.MemberRemoved: '%s' has been removed from the group.
GroupPermissions.NoAutoAccessRules: This group does not get access to new websites automatically.
GroupPermissions.NoGroups: There are no groups yet. Create a group to manage the access of several users at once.
GroupPermissions.NoMembers: This group has no members yet.
GroupPermissions.NoSharedSegments: No segments are shared with this group yet.
GroupPermissions.NoWebsiteAccess: This group has no access to any website yet.
GroupPermissions.PatternHelpSiteGroup: Name of the website group (case-insensitive), * matches any characters.
GroupPermissions.PatternHelpUrl: Host of the website URL, e.g. *.example.com, or host and path, e.g. example.com/shop*. Case-insensitive, * matches any characters.
GroupPermissions.RemoveAccessConfirm: Are you sure you want to remove the access of the group '%1$s' to '%2$s'?
GroupPermissions.RemoveAutoAccessRuleConfirm: Are you sure you want to remove the rule '%s'? Access already given by it is kept.
GroupPermissions.RemoveCapabilityConfirm: Are you sure you want to remove the capability '%1$s' from the group '%2$s' for '%3$s'?
GroupPermissions.RemoveFromGroupConfirm: Are you sure you want to remove user '%1$s' from group '%2$s'?
GroupPermissions.RenameGroupConfirm: Are you sure you want to rename the group '%1$s' to '%2$s'?
GroupPermissions.SegmentShared: The segment '%1$s' is now shared with the group '%2$s'.
GroupPermissions.SegmentUnshared: The segment '%1$s' is no longer shared with the group '%2$s'.
GroupPermissions.SegmentsDescription: Members of this group see the segments shared with it in the segment selector, as long as they have access to the website of the segment. Only the creator of a segment and super users can edit it. Segments shared with all users are not listed.
GroupPermissions.ShareSegment: Share a segment with this group
GroupPermissions.SiteFormGroupAccessHelp: Roles of the groups for this website. Members of a group get its role. Groups that are not listed have no access through groups. Groups can also get access automatically with the rules in the group editor.
GroupPermissions.UnshareSegmentConfirm: Are you sure you want to stop sharing the segment '%1$s' with the group '%2$s'?
